modifications: Discman exterior divided into hinged lid and base; authored visual interior and softened inner rim.
Original textured headphone plug fitted to modeled socket; authored smooth cable connects both earcups.
Downloaded case normalized, closed and beveled; source tray/hinges/cover UVs preserved and artwork replaced.
Downloaded CD profile refined to 384 radial segments, 120 mm diameter, 15 mm hole and 1.2 mm thickness; original Work/Life label artwork.
Existing sticker meshes conformed to curved lid with 45-165 micron offsets and attached to hinge.
Clamped Bezier insertion, vertical seating, lid closure and reflective LCD startup; 3.8 seconds with artistically compressed reading time.
2K Discman and 1200-pixel artwork retained; shared CC0 studio HDR for lighting and reflections.
